calculation.expression: if lagged_fraction(3d_return < 0) >= rolling_120d_quantile(0.70), then -asset_3d_return, else null; cross-sectional median demean
calculation.description: Fades three-day asset returns on sessions following an unusually broad cross-asset decline. The breadth condition is computed from the prior completed day and its trailing 120-day history, avoiding look-ahead. Signals are median demeaned across the 15 tradable instruments on active dates.

validation.regime_notes: Full synthetic history across pandemic, inflation/rate, risk-on, and crypto-volatility regimes; active only on downside-breadth extremes. Small 15-instrument cross-section requires conservative interpretation.
